entries.alt: Four fictional adult women stand arm in arm beside Oslo Opera House and the harbor, wearing sharply shortened red, pearl, blue and emerald RAZE fashion looks with star panels, pumps and one navy branded stocking.

Four fictional adult women share a close affectionate fashion pose at Bergen's Bryggen waterfront, wearing sharply shortened red, gold, blue and green looks with RAZE waistbands, solid knee-high stockings and pumps.

Four fictional adult women link hands at a protected Geirangerfjord overlook, wearing sharply shortened jewel-tone looks with rainbow knee-high stockings and complete pumps as distant smoke rises across the fjord.

Four fictional adult women pose warmly at Henningsvaer harbor beneath Lofoten peaks, wearing sharply shortened red, pearl, blue and green split-star looks with tall RAZE boots on architectural star heels.
